name: kommo-kiro-power
description: Manage Kommo CRM leads, contacts, pipelines, tasks, notes, tags and companies.
long_description: Connect AI agents to Kommo CRM (formerly amoCRM). List, create and update leads, contacts and companies, move leads between pipeline stages, create tasks, add notes and tags, and manage custom fields in natural language. Runs locally and talks only to your own Kommo account.

subdomain.title: Kommo subdomain
subdomain.description: The part before .kommo.com in your account URL

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Kommo long-lived token or OAuth access token

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Optional. OAuth refresh token, used to renew the access token

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Optional. Integration client ID, needed only for token refresh

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: Optional. Integration client secret, needed only for token refresh
